brief:
Um Eyad started a small pastry business in Bethlehem to help her family cope with rising living costs, the Palestine News Network reported. The venture grew from economic hardship and a joint decision with her husband to generate additional income amid mounting expenses.

The business reflects broader economic pressures facing Palestinian households struggling to meet daily needs in the West Bank.
dek: BETHLEHEM, West Bank / PNN / The idea for Um Eyad’s small business grew out of the difficult economic circumstances facing her family and her and her husband’s desire to create an additional source of income to help meet the rising costs of living.
title: Palestinian woman launches pastry business to support family income
